sources.title: Z.ai GLM-5.3-Flash (Ox Alpha) open weights under MIT (2026-08-26)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Z.ai confirmed on 2026-08-26 that stealth preview Ox Alpha (OpenRouter, free from 08-20) is GLM-5.3-Flash with MIT-licensed HF weights.
claims.context: Reveal facts via secondary + official X ledger rows; Z.ai blog + HF card are verification targets.

claims.text: Reported specs: 320B MoE / 18B active, 1M-token multimodal input, 131K-token output, sparse + linear attention, 30T-token training.
claims.context: Spec figures relayed; need HF card verification.

claims.text: Vendor-claimed benchmark results (GDPval-AA v2 top vs Opus 4.8 / GPT-5.6 Terra / Gemini 3.7 Flash; AutomationBench 2nd) and 10x cost claim are unreproduced.
Anonymous-preview usage volume figures (20-42T tokens) are platform/press-reported and inconsistent across accounts.
claims.context: Treat as momentum color, not measurement.
